content.text: Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling 2025 is the state counselling conducted for admission to Ayush Courses: BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSM/BHMS. The CG Ayush Counselling is conducted by the Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh . The NEET examination qualification is the primary criterion based on which the counselling is undertaken. The Ayush colleges participating in the counselling are recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and National Commission for Homeopathy (NCH). Seats are offered for students all over India under two categories of State Quota and All India Quota.
NEET-UG 2025 was held on May 4, 2025; NEET-UG 2025 results were published on June 14, 2025. CG Ayush Counselling dates are to be announced officially.

Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh handles the Ayush Counselling in Chhattisgarh for all the Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses. To participate in the counselling, the candidates have to register with the Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling official website at https://cgayush.admissions.nic.in/ . Students with higher secondary education in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects, along with NEET-UG qualification of that current year, are eligible to participate in the counselling.

The admissions are offered under the State quota, with 85% seats reserved only for the domicile students of Chhattisgarh, and the All India Quota (AIQ), with 15% of seats open to all, including non-domicile or students from other states. All India Quota seats counselling is conducted by the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee ( AACC C) .
There are 7 BAMS colleges , 3 BHMS colleges, 1 BUMS college, and 1 BNYS college in Chhattisgarh. Currently, there are no BSMS colleges in the state.

items: Register online through the website of the Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh, https://cgayush.admissions.nic.in/.

content.text: Here is the procedure involved in the Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling under the All India Quota, conducted by the AACCC .

items: Candidates must register with the official website of AACCC at www.aaccc.gov.in to participate in the counselling.
Submit the application with relevant personal/academic details and upload the necessary documents.
Make payment of the counselling fees to complete the registration.
Candidates must fill in the choices of colleges and the state according to their preference.
It is mandatory to lock the choice before the deadline.
Seats are allotted in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Mop-up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round.
Allotments are made according to the NEET scores, merit rank, reservation policy, and the choices of the college.

The Allotment List is published in the official website of AACCC. Log in with the credentials and download the Allotment Letter.
The candidates must report to the allotted college with the necessary original certificates for verification and make payment of the fees within the stipulated time.

Make payment of the counselling fees to complete the registration.

Choice Filling/ Locking

Candidates must fill in the choices of colleges and the state according to their preference.

It is mandatory to lock the choice before the deadline.

Seats are allotted in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Mop-up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round.
